subject: planner: move base physical agg related logic into physical op dir. (#62612)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: refactors aggregation base logic by moving `basePhysicalAgg`/MPP run-mode constants and related helpers (pushdown checks, split partial/final agg, explain/resolve-indices, avg-for-MPP rewrite) into `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop` as `physicalop.BasePhysicalAgg`, updates call sites, and wires `InitForHash/InitForStream` via `utilfuncp` function pointers to avoid import cycles. Compared key moved logic (e.g., `CheckAggCanPushCop`, `BuildFinalModeAggregation`, `RemoveUnnecessaryFirstRow`, `NewPartialAggregate`/`ConvertAvgForMPP`) against prior definitions and found it mechanically relocated with no semantic changes affecting planner correctness, SQL semantics, session/runtime behavior, or MPP/task handling.
